audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant holds by construction. `total_supply` is modified only in `increase_ctoken_supply` (L271) and `decrease_ctoken_supply` (L281), which atomically call `ctoken_supply.increase_supply`/`decrease_supply` respectively — the two fields are always kept in sync. All ctokens minted flow directly into obligations via `handle_mint` → `obligation.deposit_ctoken`, and all ctokens are burned only after being extracted from obligations via `obligation.withdraw_ctokens`. Sui's linear-type system enforces that `Balance<CToken>` cannot be duplicated or silently dropped, so `supply_value() == sum(obligation.ctokens)` at all times, with undeposited ctokens always zero.
